description: A configuration session where six entities change value mid-conversation (project rename, database switch, region move, ownership transfer, log-level round trip, cache resize). Stresses current-vs-stale entity state in segment 8: the summary must carry latest values and ideally the change history.

transcript.content: Set up my project preferences: project name 'aurora-web', database 'postgres', region 'us-east-1', owner 'priya@acme.io', and log level INFO.
Preferences recorded: project aurora-web, database postgres, region us-east-1, owner priya@acme.io, log level INFO. Everything else will default to the platform baseline.
Actually the team decided the project will be called 'aurora-portal' instead.
Renamed: the project is now aurora-portal (previously aurora-web).
We're also switching the database to MySQL 8 to match the platform standard.
Database updated: MySQL 8 (previously postgres). The connection settings will need the MySQL driver; everything else is unchanged.
What's the current region?
The region is still us-east-1.
Move deployment to eu-west-1. The French office needs lower latency.
Region updated: eu-west-1 (previously us-east-1), to lower latency for the French office.
Priya left the team. The new owner is 'sam@acme.io'.
Owner updated: sam@acme.io (previously priya@acme.io).
Raise the log level to DEBUG for the staging phase.
Log level raised: DEBUG (previously INFO) for the staging phase.
What are the current values of all settings?
Current settings: project aurora-portal, database MySQL 8, region eu-west-1, owner sam@acme.io, log level DEBUG.
Add a new setting: cache backend 'redis', max memory 512mb.
Added: cache backend redis with a 512mb max memory limit.
Actually make the cache memory 1gb. 512mb was too tight.
Cache max memory updated: 1gb (previously 512mb).
Lower the log level back to INFO now that staging is done.
Log level restored: INFO (previously DEBUG), since staging is complete.
Final check: recite every current setting.
Current settings: project aurora-portal, database MySQL 8, region eu-west-1, owner sam@acme.io, log level INFO, cache backend redis with 1gb max memory.
Also, the project moves to the git repository 'acme/aurora-portal-service'.
Repository recorded: acme/aurora-portal-service.
And confirm the owner email once more for the handover doc.

Owner is sam@acme.io. Full current state: project aurora-portal; database MySQL 8; region eu-west-1; owner sam@acme.io; log level INFO; cache backend redis with 1gb max memory; repository acme/aurora-portal-service.

facts.text: The project was initially named aurora-web and renamed to aurora-portal.
The database started as postgres and was switched to MySQL 8 to match the platform standard.
Deployment region moved from us-east-1 to eu-west-1 so the French office gets lower latency.
Ownership transferred from priya@acme.io to sam@acme.io because Priya left the team.
The log level went INFO, then DEBUG for the staging phase, then back to INFO.
The cache backend redis was added with 512mb max memory and then raised to 1gb.
Final settings: project aurora-portal; database MySQL 8; region eu-west-1; owner sam@acme.io; log level INFO; cache backend redis with 1gb max memory; repository acme/aurora-portal-service.
When queried mid-session, the region was still us-east-1 (before the move).

qa_probes.answer: To lower latency for the French office.
